acceptance_criteria.criterion: `renderChunksToDialogue('')` returns a non-empty string ending in `\n` containing `*No dialogue recorded.*`
A chunk file containing only text-bearing AI messages renders all text as plain paragraphs with no `## Role` headings and no `# Dialogue` document header
An `edit_file` tool call renders as `Tool call: \`edit_file\`` followed by `↳ [filename](/path)` with no JSON fenced block; `write_file` and `read_file` follow the same pattern

An `execute` tool call renders the abbreviated command in a `` ↳ `…` `` line; when a matching ToolMessage exists, the last meaningful output line and `✓` (exit code 0) or `✗` (non-zero) are appended as a second `↳` line
A non-`execute`, non-`task` ToolMessage produces no visible output in the rendered Markdown
A `write_todos` tool call renders as a compact checklist with `- [x]` / `- [ ]` status markers
A `task` tool call renders `↳ Sub-agent: **subagent_type**` and, when a matching ToolMessage exists, the first line of the result as a second `↳` line
`glob`, `grep`, and `ls` tool calls render only `Tool call: \`name\`` with no `↳` detail line

All `ledger_*` tools render with contextual `↳` summaries matching the per-tool rendering rules table in the plan (mutation tools show WP/type/status details; query tools show agent/WP identifiers; no-detail variants show header only)
Unknown tools render with just `Tool call: \`name\`` and no detail line (always visible, never hidden)
Sub-agent namespaces are separated and labelled with `### Subagent: …` headings
Multi-chunk tool call args (partial `input_json_delta` across chunks with same `id`) are reassembled correctly before rendering
The `renderChunksToDialogue` function is a pure function with no I/O, no side effects, and no imports from `mcp-server/src/` (gui layer separation)
All existing `renderChunksToMarkdown` tests pass unchanged; `renderChunksToMarkdown` continues to produce verbose Markdown with `## Role` headings (no regression)
All new tests in the `renderChunksToDialogue` describe block pass

The formatWriteTodosDetail helper renders checklist items directly as ↳-free lines (no ↳ prefix), unlike other family formatters. The caller pushes all return values verbatim, so the visual result is correct — just worth noting for future contributors adding similar formatters.

comments.note: EDGE2 behaviour note (not a bug): when execute ToolMessage has output but no [Command succeeded/failed with exit code N] footer, extractExecuteResult defaults success=true and still renders the last output line with ✓. This is a safe default — truncated streams or unusual tool outputs will show the last line with ✓ rather than being silently hidden. No AC requires specific footer-absent behaviour, so this is acceptable. Worth documenting for future contributors.

EDGE3: extractExecuteResult does not truncate long last-output lines — a 200-char summary line is rendered verbatim in the ↳ line. For typical shell output this is fine, but extremely long single-line outputs (e.g. minified JSON dumps) could produce very wide ↳ lines in the rendered Markdown. No AC requires truncation; flagging as a low-priority improvement opportunity.

write_todos with empty todos array renders the header only (Tool call: write_todos) with no checklist lines. This is correct per formatWriteTodosDetail's guard (returns [] when todos.length === 0). A future enhancement could render a '(no todos)' note for clarity, but current behaviour is not a defect.

comments.note: [documentation-forward] formatWriteTodosDetail (chunk-renderer.ts ~line 861) returns raw checklist lines ('- [x] content') without the '↳ ' prefix, unlike every other formatter called by getToolDetailLines. The function's JSDoc does not mention this return-shape divergence. A future contributor adding a similar formatter will look at the sibling functions (formatFileToolDetail, formatExecuteDetail, etc.) which all return '↳ …' strings, and will incorrectly assume write_todos items should also start with '↳'. Add a @remarks note to the JSDoc explaining that this function intentionally returns raw Markdown list items because write_todos renders a checklist, not arrow-prefixed summary lines, and that getToolDetailLines pushes return values verbatim.

The nsMap.size === 0 early exit in renderChunksToDialogue returns the sentinel '*No dialogue recorded.*\n'. An edge case exists where JSONL contains only ToolMessages (no AI messages) — nsMap will be non-empty but renderDialogueMessages will produce zero output lines. After trailing-blank-line trimming, lines will be empty and the result will be just '\n'. This is a cosmetic corner case (real chunk files always contain AI messages) but could surprise callers expecting the sentinel string in this scenario. Not a blocking issue.

No Fix-Forward changes were applied — the implementation is clean. All reviewed files are consistent with the spec and each other. The single pre-existing test failure in run-log-server.test.ts is confirmed unrelated to this WP.
